data.name: AutoHdrSteam_OfferText
data.value: If you launch {0} directly in Steam, HDRpilot only reliably learns about the launch through the Steam launch option, and this game doesn't have it yet. Without it, Auto HDR is only certain to work when launched via HDRpilot or an “(HDR)” shortcut. Should HDRpilot copy it? You have to add it in Steam yourself: right-click the game > Properties > General > Launch options. Auto HDR stays on either way.

data.name: AutoHdrSteam_Copied
data.value: Copied. In Steam: right-click the game > Properties > General > Launch options, paste it there. Then HDRpilot turns on HDR and Auto HDR before the game even when launched from Steam (HDRpilot must be running).

data.name: Launch_Hint
data.value: Turns HDR on, waits for confirmation and then launches the game (via its launcher or directly via the EXE).

data.name: Launch_NoCommand
data.value: HDRpilot doesn't know a launch EXE for this entry: the folder contains none or more than one. Detection while playing still works. To launch via HDRpilot, add the game via its EXE.

data.name: Launch_NoCommandQuiver
data.value: HDRpilot doesn't know a unique launch EXE for this Quiver game: the game folder contains several candidates, the EXE is nested very deep, or Quiver runs a script (BAT or CMD), which HDRpilot doesn't execute. Launch the game once in Quiver and choose the EXE there when Quiver asks; after “Rescan”, HDRpilot launches it directly. Detection while playing still works.

data.name: Details_DuplicateOfManual
data.value: The same game is also in the library as your own entry “{0}”, for the same folder. HDRpilot doesn't remove anything by itself: if you no longer need your own entry, remove it in its details with “Remove from library”.

data.name: Details_DuplicateOfQuiver
data.value: HDRpilot also reads this game from Quiver (“{0}”), for the same folder. HDRpilot doesn't remove anything by itself: if you no longer need this entry of your own, remove it below with “Remove from library”.

data.name: Details_QuiverWindowsInstaller
